templates.name: Acme Docs
templates.compose:
services:
  docs:
    image: nginx:alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    x-provelox:
      expose: true
      port: 80

templates.name: Acme Cache
templates.description: A Redis with a password you choose, for our services to share.
templates.compose:
services:
  redis:
    image: redis:7
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: ["redis-server", "--requirepass", "${REDIS_PASSWORD}"]
    volumes:
      - data:/data
volumes:
  data:

templates.name: Postgres with Adminer
templates.description: A database with a web page to browse it.

variables.label: Password
variables.description: Generated for you. Replace it if you like.

templates.compose:
services:
  db:
    image: postgres:17
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: ${DB_USER}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_DB: ${DB_NAME}
    volumes:
      - data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
  adminer:
    image: adminer:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on: [db]
    x-provelox:
      expose: true
      port: 8080
volumes:
  data:
